subject: Tighten orch-gate-bash write-pattern detection (write_text, write_bytes)
description:
hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh catches redirects, cp/mv, tee, sed -i, open(...,'w'), and .write( — but Path.write_text() / write_bytes() bypass the detector (confirmed: python3 -c 'Path(p).write_text(...)' does not match). This gap applies to ALL harnesses once shell gate is wired.

Scope:
- Extend WRITE_PATTERN in hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh for .write_text(, .write_bytes(, and any other common pathlib/stdlib helpers worth one regex
- Add regression cases to test/orch-gate-bash.test.js (blocked for unclaimed subagent → exit 2)
- No per-adapter logic duplication — adapters only relay; fix lives in shared hooks/
